title: Make it Craftable
description: A mod which makes most uncraftable items craftable.
body:
Tired of finding rare items you can’t craft? This mod changes that. It adds balanced crafting recipes for most of the items that are normally uncraftable in vanilla Minecraft—things like saddle, name tag, horse armor, and more.

Not overpowered: Every recipe is designed to feel fair and fit naturally into the game’s progression. You won’t suddenly be swimming in rare loot; you’ll just have the ability to create what you need when you’ve earned the resources.

Perfect for players who enjoy a survival experience without excessive grind or RNG.

Use JEI for crafting recipes.
